annotations.title: Read a FAR or DFARS section

description:
One FAR or DFARS section's full text (paragraphs), its part and subpart, the sections it
    refers to and the ones referring to it, and Federal Register rules changing its part. Cite
    it as FAR <section> (or DFARS) with the as-of date in source.

section.description: A FAR or DFARS section number, e.g. "52.204-21", "19.502-2" or "252.204-7012".
